description:
We have documentation in `docs\src\content\docs\` directory.  In the last 10 sprints we expanded the API coverage tremendously so we need to update documentation.

## Critical
Use the `docs-writer` skill for writing documentation

## Examples
Please provide extensive documentation not only of parts and APIs that C# bindings of Automerge offer, but provide extensive and in depth examples ranging from basic usage, itermediate and complex.

- Current documentation is one page per topic but Automerge is really complex so these pages are long and examples on those pages are then hard to find, track and read. Split (and write new) pages into logical groups of multiple pages for a topic with one (detailed) example per page.
- We need to cover examples for rich text editing, document handling/loading/saving/forking, syncing across multiple docs/clients etc... all possible usages of automerge.
- Use tests as a source for writing examples. There are lots of good code across the whole Automerge API that can be used as a source and topics for examples

**design.md** — Complete architecture:

**implementation-plan.md** — 16 sprints:
- Sprints 1-2: Scaffold + migrate existing pages, maps/lists advanced
- Sprints 3-4: Cursors, rich text (marks, blocks, spans)
- Sprints 5-7: History, branching, conflicts, persistence, sync, object graph
- Sprints 8-9: Repo layer documentation
- Sprints 10-11: API reference (core document + types/repo)
- Sprints 12-15: Four example Avalonia apps (one per sprint)
- Sprint 16: Polish, final sidebar, build verification
